method: Six same-input comparisons using the same Claude writer, one first-reveal request per version. The first input is the owner-provided tone reference and is a direction check, not held-out evidence; the other five inputs are fresh. BEFORE uses the prior reaction-v11 configuration; AFTER changes writing examples, lane mix, tone calibration and safety framing for an opt-in adult roast. No regeneration or cherry-picking after responses. Failed, blocked and alternate-model responses remain attempts and are never substituted. Profanity is a descriptive voice measure, not a quality score. No human ratings yet.
